subject: Issues loading transect shapefiles with DSsim

messages.author: d2e6f7c70e669ae3
messages.subject: Issues loading transect shapefiles with DSsim
parts:
Hi all,

I am working with DSsim and am trying to load a shapefile of line transects.  I created the shapefile manually in ArcGIS desktop and exported to a folder called "transects" in my R working directory.  Attempting to load transects with the following code:

new.directory <- paste(getwd(), "transects", sep = "/")
subjective.design <- make.design(transect.type = "Line", design.details = c("user specified"),  region = region, plus.sampling = FALSE, path = new.directory)

and then run a test simulation with this code:

ddf.analyses <- make.ddf.analysis.list(
  dsmodel = list(~cds(key = "hn", formula = ~1), #half-normal model
                 ~cds(key = "hr", formula = ~1)),               #hazard-rate model
  method = "ds", criteria = "AIC")

my.simulation.subjective <- make.simulation(reps = 10, single.transect.set = TRUE, 
                                            region.obj = region, 
                                            design.obj = subjective.design, 
                                            population.description.obj = pop.description, 
                                            detectability.obj = detect, ddf.analyses.list = ddf.analyses)

When I begin to plot the results and loaded transects, some transects appear in full but only small segments of others show up.  

transects <- generate.transects(my.simulation.subjective)
plot(region)
plot(transects, col = 4, lwd = 3)

I've attached plots of what shows up in R, and a screen capture of what my transects are supposed to look like.

I'm thinking that the issue might have to do with the fact that I created the shapefile in ArcMap and not Distance, so I might need to delete, create, or edit the attribute table to perfectly match whatever output Distance generates.

Any ideas much appreciated,

messages.author: d2e6f7c70e669ae3
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Issues loading transect shapefiles with DSsim
parts:
Hi all,

I figured this out.  The problem had to do with the number of vertices on the transects within ArcMap.  You cannot have more than two vertices per transect, otherwise the shapefile will not load properly.

Thanks,
